stem: Drag the bars to build a set of ${=n}$ values whose range is ${=t}$. Remember: range = greatest value − smallest value.
solution: The range is the greatest value minus the smallest value.
Choose a smallest value, for example 1.
Make the greatest value the smallest plus the target range.
Place the other values anywhere between them; the range does not change.
notes: The lesson lists no anchor book questions, so parent_question_id is empty. bar_builder in range mode can only emit off-target, which fires for many reasons (e.g. using the largest value, or the mean, as the range). It is mapped to the equal-means misconception only weakly; the idea that many different sets share a range, and that sets with the same mean can have very different ranges, is shown live by the bars rather than diagnosed.
